title: One Hack Wiped Out $1.57 Billion in a Day 🚨
alt_hooks: $6.3 billion gone in the largest crypto heist in history.
How did a $6.3 billion hack wipe out $100 billion from crypto in hours?
The biggest exchange exploit ever just happened. Here is where the money went.

scenes.line: $1.57 billion. Wiped out in a day by one hack.
October 29. Hackers drain $6.3 billion from Binance, and Bitcoin starts to slide.
By the next day, Bitcoin hits $76,400. A six-week low.

receipt.headline: BTC price falls to $76,400 Binance hack triggers $1.57 billion in liquidations: Crypto Markets Today

scenes.line: Traders panic. $1.57 billion in leveraged bets get liquidated.
So where did the stolen money go? Straight into a freeze.
Tether froze $1.5 billion, Circle $800 million, and Ripple about $200 million.
CZ's take? Mt. Gox lost 650,000 bitcoins, so this one is smaller in coin terms.

receipt.headline: CZ Says the Binance Hack Is Smaller Than Mt. Gox in Bitcoin Terms. What Did Bitcoin Do After Mt. Gox?

scenes.line: Then Binance paid it back. 95% of losses covered, and withdrawals are open again.

receipt.headline: Binance Resumes Crypto Withdrawals After Record Hack, 95% of Losses Covered

scenes.line: One hack. $1.57 billion liquidated. All in a day.

lesson: Never keep all your crypto on a single exchange.
description: On October 29, 2026, hackers drained $6.3 billion from Binance. By the next day Bitcoin fell to about $76,400, a six-week low, and $1.57 billion in leveraged positions were liquidated. Tether, Circle and Ripple froze about $3 billion of the stolen funds, and Binance says it covered 95% of losses as withdrawals reopened.
pinned: Did the Binance hack make you move your coins off exchanges?
